events.title: Zhu Yuanzhang proclaims the Ming dynasty
events.description: The former peasant and rebel leader declared himself the Hongwu Emperor at Nanjing. The Ming drove out the Mongol Yuan and ruled China for 276 years.
events.html: The former peasant and rebel leader declared himself the Hongwu Emperor at Nanjing. The Ming drove out the Mongol Yuan and ruled China for 276 years.

events.title: Shaanxi earthquake, the deadliest on record, strikes China
events.description: An earthquake centred in the Wei River valley killed an estimated 830,000 people. Many died when cave dwellings carved into soft loess cliffs collapsed.
events.html: An earthquake centred in the Wei River valley killed an estimated 830,000 people. Many died when cave dwellings carved into soft loess cliffs collapsed.

events.title: Elizabeth Blackwell becomes the first woman to earn a US medical degree
events.description: Admitted to Geneva Medical College in New York almost as a joke, Blackwell graduated top of her class. She went on to found hospitals and a medical college for women.
events.html: Admitted to Geneva Medical College in New York almost as a joke, Blackwell graduated top of her class. She went on to found hospitals and a medical college for women.

events.title: Netherlands refuses to hand over Kaiser Wilhelm II
events.description: The Dutch government rejected Allied demands to extradite the former German Emperor for trial under the Treaty of Versailles. Wilhelm lived in exile at Doorn until his death in 1941.
events.html: The Dutch government rejected Allied demands to extradite the former German Emperor for trial under the Treaty of Versailles. Wilhelm lived in exile at Doorn until his death in 1941.

events.title: British Eighth Army captures Tripoli
events.description: Montgomery's troops entered Tripoli, three months after El Alamein, as Rommel's forces retreated into Tunisia. It ended Italy's North African empire.
events.html: Montgomery's troops entered Tripoli, three months after El Alamein, as Rommel's forces retreated into Tunisia. It ended Italy's North African empire.

events.title: North Korea seizes the USS Pueblo
events.description: North Korean vessels captured the US Navy intelligence ship off Wonsan, killing one sailor. The 82 surviving crew were held for eleven months, and the ship is still held in Pyongyang.
events.html: North Korean vessels captured the US Navy intelligence ship off Wonsan, killing one sailor. The 82 surviving crew were held for eleven months, and the ship is still held in Pyongyang.
